projects.title: Course Prerequisite Graph
bullets: Used Java and Git for a course prerequisite graph project, representing connections with adjacency lists.
Tested connected, disconnected, and cyclic examples, and explained algorithm choices and computational complexity.

projects.title: Study-Session Scheduler
bullets: Implemented a menu-driven study-session scheduler in Java using functions and collections, with input checks and handling for invalid entries.
Tested representative inputs for the study-session scheduler and recorded the expected outputs for those inputs.
